body.zh-Hant: 日本陸軍中將柳川平助被列為第十軍司令官。藤原彰的文章稱，第十軍於十月在柳川指揮下編成。
body.en: Lt Gen Heisuke Yanagawa is listed as commander of the 10th Army. Fujiwara Akira writes that the Tenth Army was formed in October under Yanagawa's command.

body.zh-Hant: 日本戰史記載，第十軍於11月5日在杭州灣一帶登陸。藤原彰說明，第十軍的任務與上海派遣軍相同，是消滅中國軍隊並保護上海地區日本人。
body.en: The Japanese monograph records that the 10th Army landed near Hangzhou Bay on 5 November. Fujiwara says its mission, like that of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, was to destroy Chinese armies and protect Japanese nationals around Shanghai.

heading.en: Placed under the Central China Area Army

body.zh-Hant: 戰史註記指出，11月7日中央當局編成中支那方面軍，以上海派遣軍與第十軍為主力。另有日本防衛研究所藏的柳川部隊法務部日記，記錄1937年10月12日至12月31日。
body.en: The monograph note says the Central Authorities organized the Central China Area Army on 7 November with the Shanghai Expeditionary Army and the 10th Army as its main force. JACAR also catalogs a Yanagawa Military Unit legal affairs diary for 12 October to 31 December 1937.
